name: finSuccEquiv_coeff_coeff
statement: Fin n →₀ ℕ) (f : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i : ℕ) : coeff m (Polynomial.coeff (finSuccEquiv R n f) i) = coeff (m.cons i) f

name: totalDegree_coeff_finSuccEquiv_add_le
statement: MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R) (i : ℕ) (hi : (finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i ≠ 0) : totalDegree ((finSuccEquiv R n f).coeff i) + i ≤ totalDegree f
